question: Who became the first Indian female athlete to win two individual Olympic medals?
solution:
The correct answer is __PV Sindhu.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the Badminton bronze medal match, PV Sindhu defeated He Bing Jiao in straight games to clinch the bronze medal at the Tokyo Games and become the first Indian woman to win two individual Olympic medals.
 
• After becoming the first Indian female athlete to win a Silver medal at the Olympics in Rio 5 years ago, PV Sindhu has become only the 2nd Indian athlete after Sushil Kumar to win 2 individual medals at the Games.
 
• PV Sindhu: Achievements
 
 
• In January 2020, PV Sindhu was awarded the Highest Civilian Award in India- Padma Bhushan.
 
• In March 2015, Sindhu was awarded the Fourth Highest Civilian Award in India- Padma Shri. 
 
• In August 2016, she was awarded the Highest Sporting Honour of India- Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna.
 
• In September 2013, PV Sindhu was awarded the Arjuna Award for outstanding performance in sports. etc.
